newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - NatWest raises airlines.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - NatWest raises airlines.

text.p: -- NatWest Securities Corp analyst Susan Donofrio said she upgraded several airline stocks due to the "unprecedented" strength of demand and declining fuel prices. Donofrio said these factors ally fears of a revenue shortfall.
-- said traffic for the major airlines increased 10.9 percent in January and 3.1 percent in February.
-- said higher demand more than offset the effect of the return of the federal excise tax last week.
-- said upgraded Delta Air Lines Inc, UAL Corp and AMR Corp to buy from hold. Also raised Southwest Airlines Co to buy from accumulate and upgraded US Airways Group Inc to accumulate from hold.
-- the Dow Jones transportation index gained 6.47 points to 2466.50.
